name: Shenzhen King Explorer Science and Technology Corporation
summary: Shenzhen King Explorer Science and Technology Corporation specializes in the creation, engineering, production, and distribution of sophisticated intelligent equipment systems. These systems are supplied to enterprises involved in civil explosive manufacturing and blasting services, both within the People's Republic of China and across international borders. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes industrial production lines for explosives and detonators, mobile and stationary bulk emulsion modules, and specialized bulk trucks designed for emulsion, ANFO, and heavy ANFO products. Additionally, the company provides portable underground charging units and dedicated underground chargers. Further offerings encompass robotic packaging lines, precise track and trace systems for explosive materials and detonators, and the advanced JWL-RMA information and equipment management systems. King Explorer also furnishes essential chemical components such as emulsifier concentrates for bulk and packaged emulsion, along with fuel phases crucial for packaged emulsion explosives. Complementing its product range, the company extends expert technical consulting services. Established in 1994, the company's main operational base is located in Shenzhen, PRC.
